rationale: Reference baseline and lineage root of the spec of the second committee, not a candidate: the slots of the root of the first committee spec in slots a0 to b3 with its weights in both eras, the root of the hinge-law spec with the burner-heating law in slots c0 to c3 with weight zero, no era told apart, the planned stop not read. No number was taken from the PSI-159 tables. The slot values are copied from the stored releases by tools/wsp/committee2_edits.py, which chooses nothing. Data-informed candidates of acme_normal-wsp-v7 are literal revisions of this release, so that the registry records them as revisions with development exposure.
